In order to answer this question, candidates should know that blood pressure decreases with distance from the heart and so will be higher when entering the capillaries than leaving the capillaries. The loss of plasma from the capillaries results in a loss of pressure as well. The composition of veins is a result of low pressure, not a cause of low pressure.

The diffusion gradient for oxygen in the lungs will not change as the partial pressure of oxygen in the lungs will not change. This leaves the 3rd statement as the only one that is correct, option A.
